mapper.select: /* SQL ID : DscsAtclDAO.myAtclCnt 설명 : 본인 토론글 등록 수 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL WHERE DSCS_ID = #{dscsId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USER_ID = (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE')

/* SQL ID : DscsAtclDAO.selectAtcl 설명 : 게시글 단건 조회 */ SELECT A.DSCS_ATCL_ID , A.DSCS_ID , A.UP_DSCS_ATCL_ID , NVL(A.ATCL_LV, 0) AS ATCL_LV , NVL(A.ATCL_SEQNO, 0) AS ATCL_SEQNO , A.DSCS_ATCL_TYCD , A.OKNOK_GBNCD , A.ATCL_TTL , A.ATCL_CTS , A.ATCL_CTS_LEN , NVL(A.INQ_CNT, 0) AS INQ_CNT , U.USERNM , A.RGTR_ID , A.REG_DTTM , A.MDFR_ID , A.MOD_DTTM , A.EDTR_USEYN , A.DELYN , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.RGTR_ID WHERE A.DSCS_ATCL_ID = #{dscsAtclId}
